about.description: ANZ is the utility and governance token for Anzen Finance, the issuer behind the USDz stablecoin and related yield products. The protocol centers on bringing cash-flowing private credit exposures onchain, with USDz positioned as a dollar-linked asset supported by a diversified collateral portfolio. ANZ aligns incentives across liquidity, governance, and protocol economics, including vote-escrow style participation.
